newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Clinton pens thanks to Nazi-hunter Wiesenthal.
newsitem.headline: Clinton pens thanks to Nazi-hunter Wiesenthal.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton has written to veteran Nazi hunter Simon Wiesenthal to thank him for his lifelong pursuit of those who have committed crimes against humanity, Wiesenthal said on Friday.
"I want to take this opportunity, on the 50th anniversary of the Nuremberg War Crimes Tribunal, to commend you and your life's work in the pursuit of justice," Clinton wrote.
The Vienna-based Wiesenthal, who says he helped bring more than 1,000 escaped Nazis to book in a 50-year career, is a survivor of the World War Two Nazi Holocaust.
"As you have often reminded us, the pursuit of justice requires more than punishment for past crimes," Clinton wrote.
"Our obligation to those who perished in the Holocaust includes bearing witness to acts of genocide that have occurred -- and continue to occur -- in modern times," he added.
